recipes.name: Cinnamon Sugar Tortilla Crisps
instructions: Spread butter onto each tortilla, like you are buttering toast. Alternatively, melt the butter and brush onto tortillas.
Stack the tortillas, then cut into strips, or triangles.
Spread in a single layer on a baking tray (3 tortillas should almost perfectly fit).
Bake for 5 to 8 minutes until golden and crisp.
Eat warm or at room temperature.

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: 1. Stores for 2 to 3 days in an airtight container. I cut these but cutting each tortilla into 6 strips (lengthwise), then the outer strips into 2 and all other strips into 3, this makes 16 pieces per tortilla. 2. Nutrition per piece.
